item.title: 附录-Gen3实录
item.description:
CMP 170HX 8GB -> PCIe Gen3: Unlock Record

Complete record of the PCIe Gen3 link unlock on this card, built on top of the FF fuse burns (see cmp_burn.md). Gen3 validated at ~13.3 GB/s x16-equivalent (2x Gen2). Read this before touching the PCIe patches or attempting Gen4.

Card identity / result

Field Value
SKU CMP 170HX 8GB (Hynix HBM)
PCI ID 10de:20c2
BDF 0000:01:00.0 (upstream bridge 0000:00:01.0)
Die GA100 (PMC_BOOT_0 = 0x170000A1)
Host root port Gen3 x16 (Host Max 3)
Link (this record) Gen3 trained (reduced width at measurement; x16 needs direct slot + cap mod)
Device Max 4 (Gen4 capable, fuses burned)

Measured (256 MiB pinned, tools/pcie_bandwidth.py). The link was trained at reduced width (half of the x16 capability) for these runs; the x16-equivalent columns scale the measured throughput linearly with width:

item.title: 附录-Gen4-retrain原理
item.description:
Gen4 Retrain & Reporting: Why It Works This Way

Research analysis of three observations on the unlocked CMP 170HX 8GB (GA100):

  1. Why Gen4 needs a config-space retrain instead of the RM SET_PCIE_SPEED call.
  2. How our FF/fuse + PHY state compares to the A100/A30 references.
  3. Why the system reports Gen3 while the link runs Gen4.

All source citations are from open-gpu-kernel-modules 610.43.03 (the exact driver in use) unless noted. Companion docs: cmp_gen3.md, cmp_gen4.md, cmp_burn.md.

item.title: 附录-Gen4研究
item.description:
CMP 170HX 8GB -> PCIe Gen4: Research Notes

Research synthesis for the Gen4 attempt, built on the working Gen3 x16 unlock (see cmp_gen3.md). Primary source: Consensus-Protocol/cmp170hx technical wiki (docs/frontier/pcie-gen3-gen4.md, docs/hardware/pcie-subsystem.md, docs/hardware/vbios.md), cross-checked against JRex’s fuse reference table and the lixiangwuxian Gen3 guide.

NOTE ON DATING: the Consensus-Protocol wiki is current as of 2026-07-31 and states “no Gen3 or Gen4 link has ever trained.” That is OUTDATED for Gen3 – this card runs Gen3 x16 (13.6 GB/s) via the Oct-2026 lixiangwuxian post-GSP sequence + RM staged training, with the fuses burned. The wiki’s Gen4 “unsolved” is the same kind of snapshot; its register-level analysis below is still the best available map.

item.title: 附录-PCIe-x16电容改装
item.description:
CMP 170HX PCIe x4 → x16 hardware capacitor mod

← Main guide · Русская версия

Hardware modification. This requires soldering 0402 SMD parts on a multilayer GPU PCB. A mistake can permanently damage the card. Practice on scrap hardware first if you are not comfortable with 0402 rework.

What this mod fixes

The CMP 170HX has a full mechanical x16 edge connector and the PCB routes all 16 PCIe lanes, but the factory board leaves the AC-coupling capacitors for lanes 4–15 unpopulated. Stock lane width therefore negotiates as x4.

item.title: 附录-烧写全记录
item.description:
CMP 170HX -> A100-80G: FF Burn Record

Complete record of the fuseless-fuse (FF) burns that unlocked this card, performed via voltage fault injection (VFI) on a self-built RP2040 PWMVID glitcher. Read this before attempting any further burns.

The RP2040 glitcher firmware itself is NOT part of this release. The burns below only require the burn-window register state; how you reach it is up to you – the bundled ga100vfi/ and pico-ga100vfi/ public VFI toolchains are the recommended starting point (see “Burn-window prerequisites”).

dev499 直接加载社区 NVFP4 检查点成功（W4A16 元数据改写 + TEP2 + MTP6，无社区镜像/无 GDS）：单发 decode 80K-500K 全档 96-107 t/s，比 AWQ 生产栈快 52-74%；c2×103K 竞态探针 2/2 通过、零 Xid——AWQ 栈同口径 19-26 秒必崩的 spec 每请求记账竞态在 NVFP4 栈上未复现。代价：320K+ prefill 衰减、500K TTFT 331s。

item.title: PLX拓展卡双卡BAR1修复-7.0.0-cmp内核-0913
item.description:
PLX 拓展卡双卡 170HX 初始化失败修复全记录（7.0.0-cmp 内核）

日期：2026-09-13 ｜ 状态：✅ 已修复并验证

一句话结论

两张 CMP 170HX 同时插在 PLX PEX9765 拓展卡后面时 GSP 初始化失败、nvidia-smi 卡死，根因是内核 PCI 桥窗口计算不考虑子设备 64GB 对齐导致双卡 BAR1 都退回 64MB；用 bayley 的两个内核补丁构建 7.0.0-cmp 内核后，双卡 BAR1 各 65536MB，P2P 6.7GB/s（Gen2 x16 打满）。

item.title: AWQ-INT4-vs-AutoRound-W4A16-单发速度AB-0904
item.description:
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：AWQ-INT4 vs AutoRound W4A16 单发速度 A/B（2026-09-04）

结论（TL;DR）

速度几乎无差：500K/900K 两点 prefill 与 decode 均与 AutoRound 基线持平（±3% 内，属 MTP 接受率自然波动）。AWQ-INT4 (g32) 没有速度优势，也没有劣化。选型依据只剩质量与显存驻留成本——速度不构成决策因素。

item.title: v100显卡折腾笔记
item.description:
核显配合双卡V100对AI大模型本地部署和本地出图的性能分析

核显与双卡V100的组合对AI大模型本地部署和本地出图有显著提升，主要体现在显存池化与NVLink互联带来的算力扩展，以及核显承担显示任务释放V100资源的协同效应。这种配置方案在2025年已成为性价比极高的AI本地部署选择，特别适合预算有限但需要运行32B参数级别大模型的用户。
